He said, “Most certainly I tell you, no prophet is acceptable in his hometown.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country, and among his own relatives, and in his own house.”
translations.bsb: Then Jesus said to them, “Only in his hometown, among his relatives, and in his own household is a prophet without honor.”
translations.kjv: But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, but in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.
translations.asv: And Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honor, save in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.
